scope: Bilingual package guides and public API/DSL reference

dsl.scope: Current DSL declaration exports plus public host, native, and observation types described in the DSL as cross-references. Pure JS runtime APIs are indexed separately by Core.

limits: Uses public built package entry points
Core snapshots verified against shadcn support catalog schemas; no browser DOM checks in this script
Mocks HTTP transport and secret resolution

differences.result: Public type, registration and execution allow omitted inputs when no required child input is unsupplied. Spec overview says to explicitly declare inputs. DSL describes current executable form.
Retained use can keep previous refresh and intervalMs when removed from a View update with no inherited value. New uses receive documented defaults. DSL records the observed difference.
Registry rejects /queries in State.initial and Derived inputs; this constrains public behavior despite /queries being listed in a lower-level runtime evaluator.

limitations: Browser viewport checks cover 20 representative localized pages at 320 and 1440 CSS pixels, not every page.
Query settings omitted during retained-use update can remain active; this is existing runtime behavior, not a new contract.
